findings: The supported Poky 6.0.2 linux-yocto do_compile workload held the eight-logical-CPU host at a 99.6836% trimmed-mean utilization for the complete 120-second sample window.
Daemon plus one interactive client consumed a 0.9207% trimmed mean of one logical CPU; input p95 was 5.4191 ms and every IPC continuity/cancellation check passed.

High-rate job progress updates the bounded journal incrementally, compatibility decoding is generation-cached, and a priority-aware readiness notification wakes immediately for critical work while coalescing cosmetic work.
At 90% or greater host utilization during live work, presentation coalesces to 1 Hz while input and resize stay immediate; below saturation ordinary activity remains 4 Hz.
